capabilities: replace a selected URL with extracted Markdown
replace a document's content using its link frontmatter
archive external links as internal notes in an archive folder
extract content from a clipboard URL at the cursor
extract YouTube channel name and description via youtube-dl
extras: YouTube metadata extraction only works if youtube-dl is installed on the system.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn a URL's HTML content into readable Markdown inside a note, so saving web content requires copy-paste and manual cleanup.
summary: URL extractor that converts web page content into Markdown, replacing links in the selection, document, or whole vault notes.
